summary: Skills collection with bundled helper scripts; static matches are weak keyword co-occurrences
details: Package bundles a collection of 'skills' consisting of scripts and documentation. a static rule fired on keyword co-occurrence (ping/curl/GET/POST tokens near 'install') in several bundled files: a Python base_scraper and serve_api under bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/scripts/, a benchmarks shell script under bundled-skills/loki-mode/, an install helper under bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh that references the official rclone.org domain, and a verify.sh under bundled-skills/youtube-notetaker/scripts/. These are bundled auxiliary scripts invoked by the user when they explicitly run a given skill, not lifecycle scripts that fire on npm install. The flagged destinations are the first-party domains of the tools involved (e.g., rclone.org), not attacker-controlled infrastructure, and no credential reads, environment scraping, or exfiltration pattern is present. No hardcoded C2, no obfuscated endpoints, and no install/import-time code execution path reaching the flagged files is evident.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
